module-analyzer-generate-doc 1.0.5

- Added two documentation files: FINAL_VERIFICATION_v1.0.5.md and RELEASE_NOTES_v1.0.6.md.
- Removed the skill-card.md file. 
- No changes to core workflow, logic, or activation criteria. Documentation content reorganized only.

- Adjusted activation criteria: now only triggers when users clearly request to generate or update module documentation, not just inquire about module logic.
- Enhanced safety and compliance: all destructive operations (delete/move/modify docs or folders) strictly require prior explicit user confirmation—absolutely no automated deletion.
- Updated doc quality check and reporting: low-quality or misplaced docs are only reported, not automatically altered, and require user review before any changes.
- Clarified handling of file read failures: retry strategy expanded (including limited fallback read options), but restricted to safe, read-only operations.
- Removed the sample skill-card.md file.

## v1.0.0 (2026-03-07)

### English
- Initial release of module-analyzer-generate-doc skill
- Single-module deep analysis for Java/Maven projects
- L3 file-level documentation with natural language business descriptions
- L2 module-level documentation with architecture overview and business flows
- Multi-subagent parallel processing (default 5 subagents, 10-16 files per chunk)
- Automatic context compression (every 2-3 files)
- Automatic retry with exponential backoff (max 3 retries)
- Checkpoint & resume support with state file tracking
- Scheduled progress reporting (every 20 minutes)
- Smart skip mechanism for DTO/VO/Entity/Enum/Interface/Test classes
- Secondary scan for missing document detection
- Comprehensive documentation templates (L3/L2)
- Task execution guide with detailed workflow

### 中文
